title: Nac's Lime Copper Lights
description: All Copper lights will have a Nice lime green Color!
body:
# A Nicer Green!
Inspired on what's seen on the snapshots.

The textures of **_ALL_** copper lights will be a **vibrant lime-green** color!

instead of the vanilla's sad, _pale green_.

![A comparison of the copper lanterns, bulbs, golems, and torch's vanilla textures vs my textures. Only making all of the "Light" parts be lime green, like the eyes, torch heads, lantern lights, and bulb's glow.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9b59a6f27ae12065af19d7d34cbf76199bf5e6b.gif)

<details>
<summary>List of changed textures</summary>

- Copper Torch (and Copper Fire Flame)
- Copper Lanterns
- Lit Copper Bulbs
- Powered, Lit Copper Bulbs
- Copper Golem Eyes
</details>

## Lite version!
Only changing the torch & Lantern so it's just a color tweak instead of a full consistency change!

Perfect for those who just want them to look nicer.
[Click to see Lite Version!](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/lime-copper-lights-alt)

<details>
<summary>Terms of Use</summary>

If you want to use my pack in another resource pack, make sure to credit me,
This also applies if you just modify the same pack, i will ask for credit.

You are free to use my pack personally and include it in videos without issue.

... As long as you don't claim that you made it, in that case i'd get angry.

</details>
